messages:
emma: Heads up — scheduling the orders->users FK rollout tonight 23:30-01:00 UTC. Plan is phased backfill + add NOT VALID constraint then validate. Tagging @raj for runbook and @marta for monitoring. Please ack. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
raj: ack. high level: 1) add nullable temporary column orders.user_id_tmp, 2) backfill in 10k batched jobs with low parallelism, 3) add FK as NOT VALID, 4) validate constraint during low traffic window, 5) remove tmp and swap. Will pin service version to v3.12 for the change window.
marta: +1. I'll create a quick Datadog dashboard for row-gap and lock wait time and add an alert if validate exceeds 60s or lock wait > 0.5s.
luke: question — why not "ADD CONSTRAINT ... NOT VALID" directly on orders.user_id? Are we keeping tmp to avoid touching hot column?
raj: good q. We keep tmp to avoid interfering with producer writes to user_id (hot updates). We backfill tmp in small batches -> then atomically set user_id = user_id_tmp under short lock or do column swap using ALTER TABLE ...
raj: runbook snippet:```bash
# backfill job (pseudocode)
psql $DB -c "UPDATE orders SET user_id_tmp = (SELECT id FROM users WHERE users.external_id = orders.user_ext) WHERE user_id_tmp IS NULL LIMIT 10000;"
# repeat until done, sleep 2s between batches
```
emma: deploy-bot will run migration job after canaries. We'll pin api and workers to v3.12 and block auto-roll for 30m after validate.
deploy-bot: canary deployment started: service=orders-api tag=v3.12 canary=5% nodes infra-5. Migration job queued (job_id=job-6752).
infra-bot: noted DB pools on prod-db-1: connections=420/500, long_tx=0. Will throttle backfill concurrency if > 450 conns.
marta: monitoring dashboard link: https://app.datadog.com/dash/123/orders-fk-rollout — added alerts for lock_wait_p90 > 200ms and queries/sec drop > 20%.
raj: during validate step, if we see advisory lock contention or validate > 90s we abort validate and roll back constraint (ALTER TABLE orders DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS fk_user_tmp). Then we will increase backfill speed or change window.
luke: ok. what's the rollback for app? If constraint add fails but canary healthy, do we revert code change?
emma: we will keep code pinned to v3.12 which tolerates both states (uses user_id_tmp fallback). Only unpin if validation holds but API errors surface.
deploy-bot: job job-6752 started on runner-m3 at 2026-03-20T23:31:05Z. Step=add-col.
deploy-bot: step=backfill batch=1/80 rows=10000 elapsed=12s
deploy-bot: step=backfill batch=5/80 rows=10000 elapsed=58s
infra-bot: alert: lock_wait_p99 spike 1.2s on prod-db-1 during batch 7. Throttling backfill concurrency +1s sleep.
raj: paused automated batches for 3m to let locks clear. will resume at reduced parallelism (2 workers).
marta: alert muted for 10m while we stabilize. Logging all incidents to the rollout channel.
deploy-bot: step=backfill batch=40/80 rows=10000 elapsed=29m. ETA remaining ~30m.
luke: if validate still looks risky, we can run VALIDATE CONSTRAINT on a subset using index-ordered partitions? Might be heavy.
raj: agree. fallback: run ALTER TABLE ADD CONSTRAINT ... NOT VALID then run `ALTER TABLE ... VALIDATE CONSTRAINT fk_user_tmp` during a scheduled maintenance if low traffic next day. For tonight we'll try live validate but abort if >60s.
deploy-bot: step=add-constraint NOT VALID applied. Step=validate queued.
infra-bot: warning: connection spikes on replica during validate queue. Throttle validate start by 20s.
raj: starting validate now (manual) — watching locks and queries.
deploy-bot: step=validate started job-6752-validate.
infra-bot: ERROR: validate blocked by long-running statement id=2143 (duration 240s). Abort recommended.
raj: aborting validate. issuing ALTER TABLE orders DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS fk_user_tmp; rolling back column swap plans.
deploy-bot: validate aborted, constraint dropped, job job-6752 marked partial-success (backfill completed, validate aborted).
emma: decision: rollback plan accepted. We'll keep tmp column and backfill complete, schedule validate for maintenance window tomorrow 04:00 UTC when traffic < 5%. Reopening incident for post-mortem. Thx everyone. :tada:
